proposal.description: OVP is recorded only during soft start, on the belief that an analog overvoltage can only be the overshoot at the end of the soft-start ramp, so an OVP trip in S_RUN (a load dump, say) is not recorded
proposal.reason: If the analog comparator trips the latch while run_active is high and latch_assert is low, bit 4 of fault_reg stays clear. fault_time is still stamped because episode_start fires, so the host reads a timestamp with no cause bit set. An OVP during S_SS is still recorded.
